description.value: A long-running specialty food store (formerly Galloway's, dating back to the 1930s on Robson Street) now located in New Westminster. Stocks a large selection of spices, grains, coffee, ethnic foods, organic items, and gluten-free products not found in conventional grocery stores. Small and cozy with knowledgeable staff and a reputation as a destination shop for customers across the Lower Mainland.

address.value: 702 Sixth Ave, New Westminster BC V3M 2B3

bike_parking_detail: 7 racks within 100m: stands at 7m; stands at 37m; rack (covered) at 69m; stands (6 spaces) at 80m; stands at 88m; wall_loops (9 spaces) at 95m; stands (6 spaces) at 97m. Total: 21 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website confirms this is an active specialty food store at 702 Sixth Ave, New Westminster (not North Vancouver as the candidate record states — V3M postal code is New Westminster). Phone and address match between OSM and website. The store clearly sells groceries (spices, grains, coffee, organic/ethnic foods, gluten-free items) confirmed by multiple website pages. No mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or any cycling-specific amenities on the website.
concerns: OSM candidate record lists community as 'North Vancouver' but the store is clearly in New Westminster (confirmed by website address and V3M postal code)
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active specialty grocery store with large inventory of food items useful for resupply. Located on a main avenue in New Westminster accessible by bike.
enrichment_extras.notes: Formerly known as Galloway's (OSM old_name tag). Contact page states they do not take orders by mail or email.
